content: {"summary": "Apple stopped reporting under the legacy us‑gaap Revenues concept after FY2018 because it adopted the new ASC 606 revenue recognition standard beginning in FY2019, switching to the ‘RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax’ concept instead. Consequently, there are no Revenues facts (zero or otherwise) for Apple in fiscal years after 2018."}
